Definition:
Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control
Programme NTBLCP/TB 01 Presumptive TB Register for drug-susceptible and
drug-resistant tuberculosis. One model instance represents one facility
register reporting period and contains repeatable client entries covering
registration, presumptive-TB classification, referral source, specimen
processing, diagnostic investigations, HIV activities, investigation outcome
and linkage to TB treatment.
Identifier assigned to the presumptive TB register or its electronic equivalent.
State in which the facility maintaining the register is located.
Local Government Area in which the facility maintaining the register is located.
Reference to the health facility or service delivery site maintaining the register, when available.
Name of the site maintaining the presumptive TB register.
Clinic code recorded in the source register.
Monthly reporting period represented by the Month and Year fields in the source register.
One client-level row in the NTBLCP/TB 01 Presumptive TB Register.

Definition: Reference to the corresponding Nigeria Core Patient resource, when available.
Sequential number assigned to the client in the register.
Date the client was registered as a presumptive TB client.
Hospital or clinic identifier assigned to the client.
Full name of the client.
Age of the client in years as recorded in the source register.
Client sex. The source register records M or F.
Full residential address of the client.
Identification number assigned to the specimen submitted for TB investigation.

Indicates whether the client is presumptive drug-susceptible TB or
drug-resistant TB. Source values are DS-TB and DR-TB.
Constraint(s): Type of presumptive TB: DS-TB / DR-TB
DR-TB: Enter code - a / b / c

Definition: Indicates whether the client is a health care worker.
Constraint(s): Is client a health worker? Y/N

Definition:
Source from which the presumptive TB client was referred.

Source register abbreviations:
ART = ART Facility
OPD = Outpatient Department
DOTS = DOTS Facility
CP = Community Pharmacist
PPM = PPM Scheme
CV = Community Volunteer
TB Px = TB patient
PMV = Patent Medicine Vendor
CTW = Community TB Worker
CI = Community Informant
O = Other form of referral.
Constraint(s): Who referred the client? Source of referral

Definition: Narrative description when the source of referral is recorded as Other.

Presumptive site of TB disease. The source requires one of:
Pulmonary or Extra-Pulmonary.
Specimen-processing dates for Xpert MTB/RIF or AFB microscopy.

RIF resistance not detected,
RIF resistance detected,
RIF resistance indeterminate.

Definition: Name or type of other diagnostic test, for example TB-LAMP or LF-LAM.
Test result. Expected source values are Positive, Negative or Indeterminate.
Chest X-ray interpretation. Source values are Suggestive or Not Suggestive.
Indicates whether the client was clinically diagnosed with TB.

HIV status already known before the current presumptive-TB investigation.
Source options are Positive or Negative.
Constraint(s): HIV Activities: Previously known HIV status - Positive / Negative

Definition:
HIV testing outcome for a client whose HIV status was previously unknown.
Source options are Positive, Negative or Not Tested.
Constraint(s): HIV Activities: Previously unknown HIV status - Tested for HIV Positive / Negative / Not Tested

Definition:
Final classification following the presumptive-TB investigations.
Source categories are:
DSTB,
DRTB,
Not TB.
Constraint(s): Outcome of investigations: DSTB / DRTB / Not TB

Definition: Indicates whether a client diagnosed with TB started TB treatment.
LGA TB registration number assigned when the patient starts treatment.
Constraint(s): If yes: LGA TB Reg No. above

Definition: Date TB treatment was initiated.
Additional remarks recorded for the presumptive-TB client.
